_help: The hotkey bar (HUD, bottom right): one cell per game action. x/y = the top-left of the first cell in 1366x768 game pixels. cellW/cellH = the cell box (the official cell art is 35x33), pitch = the distance between two cells. capDx/capDy = the key cap in the cell, nameDy = the action name under the cap. DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
